items.title: installing and init should select code assistant separately from the task tracking
items.description: The install + init flow forces users to pick a *combination* (e.g. `claude-gh`) from a flattened 7–8-line TUI list. The codebase mirrors this: there are seven cross-product loadout directories (`claude-jira`, `claude-notion`, `claude-gh`, `claude-local`, `kiro-notion`, `kiro-gh`, `kiro-local`).

items.title: README: add demo gif of the PM ↔ worker radio handshake
items.description: The README is dense and well-written but text-heavy. A new visitor scrolling to the radio messaging or workflow sections has no immediate visceral sense of *what the experience feels like* — multiple zellij tabs, the PM tab focusing when a worker pings, the worker waking up on `approved-and-merged`. A 30–60s demo recording is the single highest-ROI step for adoption.
